desc:
🏫 Discover HighSchool RP and create your own path inside a huge, living school!
👨‍🏫 Create your own classes and enjoy teaching other students.
🍳 Cook in an ultra-immersive system, prepare every ingredient, and serve your creations.
🛡️ Become a supervisor, enforce the rules, and work with the staff using your walkie-talkie.
🎤 Take the role of the Headmaster, organize classes, make announcements for everyone, and climb the ranks in the school.
🏀 Enjoy realistic basketball, tennis, and football courts to have fun with friends or show your skills.
📏 Become a hard-working student, show your athletic talent… or choose to be completely rebellious and stand out in school.
🔎 Explore classrooms, discover secret areas, and live an adventure full of surprises.

✨ Join HighSchool RP and dive into a fun, interactive school experience packed with activities and surprises, made for players in the United States!

#schoolrp #highschool #roleplay #voicechat #school
